mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, pda_version, remark, force, url
mapper.select: SELECT pv.id, pv.create_user_name, pv.create_time, pv.update_user_name, pv.update_time, pv.pda_version, pv.remark, pv.force, pv.url, pv.type, pv.upgrade_time, CASE WHEN pv.release_type = 0 THEN '升级通知' ELSE '系统通知' END AS releaseType FROM pda_version pv WHERE pv.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY pv.create_time DESC

SELECT id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, pda_version, remark, force, url, type, upgrade_time FROM pda_version pv WHERE pv.is_deleted = FALSE AND now() >= pv.upgrade_time AND pv.upgrade_time IN (SELECT MAX(upgrade_time) FROM pda_version WHERE release_type = 0) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT pusv.id FROM pda_user_skip_version pusv WHERE pv.id = pusv.version_id AND pusv.is_deleted = FALSE AND pusv.user_id = #{userId} ) ORDER BY pv.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
